methodSections.heading: Artichoke Spinach Dip
steps: Slice the green onions finely, drain and slice the artichoke hearts, roughly chop the spinach and set aside.
Add the cashews, water, garlic, nutritional yeast, onion powder, salt and pepper to a blender and blend together until smooth.
Transfer to a medium-sized pot and bring to a simmer over a medium-low heat. Stir often until it thickens; be careful as it will scorch easily.
Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice, artichoke hearts, spinach leaves, green onions and vegan mayonnaise.
Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Serve with warmed tortillas chips, crispy pita bread or as a dressing for a bowl.
